title: ReportSectionDraft
description: One report section's claims, written from the frozen report plan and the evidence code selected for this section only (§4.3). Claims cite passages and/or evidence-table cells from the StepInput allowlist. Locators, reading depth and cell values come from backend records, never from this output. Passing structural checks is not semantic verification.

section_id.description: II is written entirely by code and never calls this task.

claim_key.description: Stable within one report version; reassigned when the section is rewritten (e.g. IV.3, abstract.1).

paragraph.description: Claims sharing one paragraph number are joined into one flowing paragraph in reading view, in claim order (§9).

table_ref.description: Set only on a claim that refers to the evidence table as a whole (IV).

equation_ref.description: A displayed-equation identifier this claim's text points to; code substitutes the printed number (1), (2)... (§9).

body_refs.description: abstract, I and IX only: claim_key values of III-VIII this claim summarizes. A derived claim inherits the weakest support_type and reading depth of its body_refs (§6, computed in report/assembly.py, not by the model).

axis_id.description: III and IV theme claims only; must match a plan axis and one of this draft's subsections.

count.description: Set on a counting sentence ('4 of 6 full-text-read sources...'); code checks the members actually carry that column value and reading depth, are distinct sources, and that the numbers in the text match the member counts (§6, §8).

equation_origin.description: Set on a claim carrying a displayed equation; the named passage must be in the StepInput and among the claim's own passage_ids, and text_source must equal that passage's text_source (checked in code). That the passage itself contains a math span is not checked yet.

citation_anchors.description: One anchor per claim-evidence pair. Exactly one of passage_id/cell_id is non-null (checked in code): a cell-based claim's anchor is located in the cell's current revision's stored evidence quotes (cell_evidence_links.anchor_text via the frozen snapshot), never in the passage directly.

subsections.description: III and IV only: theme headings derived from plan axes. A subsection without a matching plan axis, or a claim's axis_id without a matching subsection here, is a schema/assembly violation.

gaps.description: VI only: candidate unanswered aspects this section introduces. corpus_absence candidates are code-generated before the call (report/gaps.py) and given via the allowlist; the model only writes their text and cites gap_refs. stated_limitation and conflicting_evidence candidates are found by the model itself and mint their own gap_id.

kind.description: This v1 schema lists the three kinds this slice supports; a fourth kind (slice 2, Chain of Ideas) is a new schema version, not an open enum here. The storage column report_gaps.kind is plain TEXT validated in code against domain.contracts.GAP_KINDS, precisely so slice 2 can extend the list without a migration.

insufficient_evidence.description: Recorded instead of forcing a claim when this section's required evidence is missing (e.g. no definition passage for a glossary term) (§4.3).
